text:
alex_kapoor: Heads up — p99 latency for hosted inference in us-east-1 just jumped from ~180ms to ~420ms around 08:04 UTC. Alerts show increased retransmits and packet drops between pods on the same node pool.
priya_gupta: ugh, saw the alert dashboard too. Any recent infra changes?
alex_kapoor: No infra deploys except a small kube autoscaler tweak last night. I ran a quick ping/iperf between two affected workers and saw ~0.8% packet loss + latency spikes.
marta_sanchez: @alex_kapoor can you paste tc output from the host? I'm wondering if someone applied a traffic shaper.
alex_kapoor: pasted below from one host (shortened):
```
# tc -s qdisc show dev eth0
qdisc htb 1: root refcnt 2 r2q 10 default 12 direct_packets_stat 0
 qdisc fq_codel 10: parent 1:12 limit 1024 target 5.0ms interval 100.0ms ecn
 Sent 1234567 bytes 1234 pkts
 backlog 0b 0p requeues 0
```
```
# tc -s class show dev eth0
class htb 1:12 root rate 1000mbit ceil 1000mbit burst 1600b
```

Seems fq_codel is attached to a child class under htb. Looks like someone applied per-host shaping with fq_codel on the class, not on ingress.
josh_h: That matches what I saw on a couple of hosts — fq_codel + a tiny burst size causing microbursts to get dropped. Also noticed txqueuelen was set to 256 on the affected hosts (we usually use 10000 for jumbo enabled hosts).
sebastian_ops: We changed a template two days ago to add 'qdisc htb ...' for an internal cost-control experiment. Guess it rolled out to the managed nodepool accidentally.
priya_gupta: That explains it. HTB with small burst + fq_codel can be very aggressive on east-west RPCs (small packets). Inference SLOs really sensitive to retransmits.
marta_sanchez: Quick mitigation — can someone remove the class/qdisc on the worst hosts and set txqueuelen back? Command I propose: `tc qdisc del dev eth0 root` then `ip link set dev eth0 txqueuelen 10000` and confirm `tc -s qdisc show` afterwards.
alex_kapoor: Doing that now on host i-0a12...
infra-bot: Incident created: INF-2026-023 — East-west packet loss due to host QoS misconfig. Pager duty notified.
ajosh_h: After removing root qdisc on i-0a12, tail latency on local inference pod dropped back to ~160ms within a minute. Re-running iperf shows drops down to <0.1%.
sebastian_ops: Rolling a fix to nodepool template to remove experiment qdisc and restore txqueuelen. Also going to add a canary so we don't push this cluster-wide.
priya_gupta: For postmortem, let's capture:
- exact nodepool template diff and who merged it
- list of affected hosts and their tc output snapshots
- why fq_codel got attached to the HTB class instead of root
- inference SLO impact graph (p50/p95/p99), and cost impact (retries)
marta_sanchez: Also check MTU settings — I saw one host with MTU 1500 while rest are 9000, could cause fragmentation and interaction with QoS. `ip link show` output included below from one host: `eth0 mtu 1500 qdisc fq_codel state UP`
ajosh_h: Note on RDMA/roce: none of these hosts are in the RDMA pool, but if we ever add qdiscs on RoCE NICs it breaks priority flow control. Add a checklist to avoid touching RDMA-enabled host templates.
alex_kapoor: Agreed. I'll start a short runbook for rollback/mitigation and add the commands we used (and `/sbin/ifdown eth0` is NOT part of it :grimacing:).
sebastian_ops: I'll open a PR to revert the experiment and include an automated verifier that checks for unintended qdiscs during node provisioning.
priya_gupta: Thanks team. Leave the incident open for now until the rollout reverts and we verify no more regressions for an hour. I'll update the SLO dashboard to annotate the window. :thumbsup:
